verses.text: A psalm by David. O Lord, who may stay in your tent? Who may live on your holy mountain?
The one who walks with integrity, does what is righteous, and speaks the truth within his heart.
The one who does not slander with his tongue, do evil to a friend, or bring disgrace on his neighbor.
The one who despises those rejected by God but honors those who fear the Lord. The one who makes a promise and does not break it, even though he is hurt by it.
The one who does not collect interest on a loan or take a bribe against an innocent person. Whoever does these things will never be shaken.
